Fitment, cap and filling route Confirm the bore, cap and fitment position together with the filling line. Trial cap torque, fitment weld integrity and dispensing with the real product. A corner spout changes pouring orientation; a centered spout changes filling access. The selected fitting needs a separate dimensioned record. Carry opening and filled weight The reference image includes a handle-related feature. The listed construction is Spout Pouch; confirm how the handle is formed and where the filled load is transferred. Review lifting, edge clearance and the actual weight rather than approving from an empty-bag photograph. Dispensing details to add to this record The opening field reads “Spout”. The listed fill options are “1KG 1.5KG 2.5KG 5KG 10KG”. Add the cap specification, bore and filling method before comparing this reference with another spout pack. Separate the print web from the sealant The listed film names need to be turned into a layer-by-layer construction. Identify the outer print web, any barrier component and the product-contact sealant. Agree total gauge and sealing conditions instead of treating a list of polymers as a finished laminate.
